hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.notebook_path // empty' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; base=${f##*/}; case "$base" in .env|.env.*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; [ "$base" = ".env.example" ] && exit 0; printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Le CLAUDE.md du projet interdit de lire, afficher ou modifier .env — il porte la cle OpenRouter et les identifiants Gramps. Utiliser .env.example comme reference."}}'; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */pyproject.toml|pyproject.toml) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; d=$(dirname "$f"); a=$(grep -m1 '^version *= *"' "$f" | cut -d'"' -f2); b=$(grep -hm1 '^__version__ *= *"' "$d"/src/*/__init__.py "$d"/*/src/*/__init__.py 2>/dev/null | cut -d'"' -f2); if [ -n "$a" ] && [ -n "$b" ] && [ "$a" != "$b" ]; then echo "Versions desaccordees : pyproject.toml=$a mais __version__=$b. La CI echouera sur test_version_matches_pyproject." >&2; exit 2; fi; }
